msg: Hi! I'm Advanced Open Water certified but my last dive was about 3 years ago. I'm staying in Cartagena old town next week and would love to do 2 days of diving. What do you recommend and how much would it be?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Two days of diving in the Rosario Islands sounds like a great plan 🌊 Since your last dive was about three years ago, a refresher is normally required before fun dives. It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course, with an instructor review and one ocean dive.

For two days, you could pair the refresher with the *2-dive Fun Dives trip* on another day. Online prices include the 10% online discount. The refresher’s exact schedule for your plan would need to be confirmed by a team advisor.

The Fun Dives depart from Cartagena, meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., and return the same day. Your stay in the Old Town is convenient for the meeting point, which is about five minutes from the historic center.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands*
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena, I told you I'm staying there. I'm Canadian. Can I do the refresher on day 1 and the 2 dives on day 2? Is lunch included?
reply:
Yes, you can do the refresher on day 1 and the 2-dive trip on day 2. The refresher includes pool training and one ocean dive with a PADI instructor; lunch is included on both days.

For the refresher, the meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. The boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m. The 2-dive trip also includes lunch.

It also includes:
• National Park entrance fee
• Mandatory dive insurance
• Diving equipment
• Eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
